channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Presentation: Spritely: Infrastructure for the Future of the Internet
item.description: Christine Lemmer-Webber and David Thompson explain how Spritely's architecture solves core decentralization challenges. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: When chat is the wrong UI
item.description: What is a developer to do when they need something more tangible than a chat box? Enter canvases. The post When chat is the wrong UI appeared first on The GitHub Blog . (1 source: githubblog)

item.title: How Cloudflare addressed a cross-tenant data exposure vulnerability in Containers
item.description: External security researchers at Accomplish identified a vulnerability in Cloudflare Containers that could expose residual disk data from previous workloads. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: AI-powered fuzzing with the GitHub Security Lab Taskflow Agent
item.description: In this blog post, I explain how to use the new fuzzing taskflow based on the GitHub Security Lab Taskflow Agent AI framework. The post AI-powered fuzzing with the GitHub Security Lab Taskflow Agent appeared first on The GitHub Blog . (1 source: githubblog)
